title: Polynomial PEPS approximation of gapped square-grid ground states
summary: We prove that the unique ground state of a uniformly gapped nearest-neighbor Hamiltonian on an $`L\times L`$ square lattice admits a projected entangled-pair state approximation with bond dimension polynomial in L and global vector error at most L −1 after normalization. Only the gap of the full Hamiltonian is assumed. The result is an existence theorem, with constants uniform over Hamiltonians of fixed local dimension, interaction strength, and gap.
family_title: Area laws and tensor networks for two-dimensional gapped systems

review.reason: Proves polynomial bond-dimension PEPS approximations exist for gapped square-lattice ground states.
